items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: It must have been just around the time Paul Baldwin was getting there with Jimmy Noon and those.

ctx.x: It was a regular six-piece band. I can't remember who was in the band. Was Louis Armstrong in it then already? No, no, Louis. Before his, that's what I wanted to hear. How old were you then? What year? Oh gosh, I was probably about, about 11 or 12.
It must have been just around the time Paul Baldwin was getting there with Jimmy Noon and those.

Yeah, it might have been pretty early, around 1918 or so. Maybe anyway. I think Joe went up there about that time, the time of the First World War. Well, there's one other question I was going to ask. I remember seeing a picture in downbeat, and I later got a copy of it, of you in sort of a military school uniform. Yes, I was playing, I think you were holding a bugle or trumpet or a cornet?
